_note: Themed name lists, each its own page at /names/<slug>. A name belongs to a collection when its 'origin' is listed in 'origins' or its 'source' starts with one of 'sourcePrefixes'. 'group' picks the heading it is listed under on /names. Slugs must contain a hyphen so they can never clash with a single name's page. Pages with fewer than 'minNames' names are skipped.
